## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.12 — Settings works again, and streaming can be stopped

> **Alpha.** Fixes nine issues found using alpha.11 on a real phone. Two were
> bugs introduced in recent alphas.

### Settings was dead — and that blocked everything

Tapping Settings did nothing, which mattered more than it sounds: it is the
only route to the diagnostics report, so the app could not be debugged from
itself.

The header intercepts navigation to hand tabs to the shell, but Settings is a
real page rather than a shell tab, so the click was cancelled and then
silently discarded. Introduced when the Settings link was added in alpha.4.

### Streaming

- **A stream could not be stopped, and the UI never noticed when one ended.**
  Stopping from the system UI, or Android reclaiming the capture service, left
  the page still claiming to stream. All four ways a stream can end now go
  through one path, and stopping releases the bridge's entertainment area
  immediately instead of waiting out a keepalive timeout.
- **Start and Stop are now one toggle.** Two buttons with one permanently
  disabled reads as broken rather than unavailable.
- **Capture ignored screen orientation.** A fixed landscape buffer on a
  portrait phone squashed the display into a letterbox, so the edge zones
  sampled black bands instead of the picture. Capture now follows the display's
  aspect and orientation.
- **Big black bars are detected properly.** The letterbox check gave up past a
  third of the frame — fine for cinematic bars on a monitor, wrong on a phone,
  where landscape video in portrait leaves roughly 35% top and bottom.

### Lights

- **The all-lights tile lagged every real lamp by a second or two, and had no
  colour preview.** It was the one card the fast-path renderer skipped. It now
  updates instantly like the rest, and it — along with the per-room tiles —
  shows a blended wash of the colours actually on.
- **Sliders swallowed scrolling.** Any upward swipe starting on a brightness
  slider dragged it instead of scrolling, which on a phone is most swipes.
- **Room headings stay pinned** while scrolling, so it is clear which room a
  card belongs to.
- **Scene favourite stars** read as filled rather than tinted the link colour.
- **The simple theme's tinted border never actually appeared** — a colour was
  being written as `rgb(undefined,undefined,undefined)`, which browsers drop
  silently.

### Android

The status bar could still cover the theme and language buttons. Added an
explicit opt-out of Android 15's forced edge-to-edge alongside the existing
inset handling.

### Known issues

See [KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
